requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) With guidance from your counselor, establish a four-week training plan that combines your chosen multisport format to develop proper techniques, gain self-confidence, and increase endurance. Each session should last at least 25 minutes and include a proper warmup before the session and stretching afterward. (b) Use a chart or other tracking method to monitor your training and development during this period. (d) At the end of four weeks, discuss your progress with your counselor and tell how your development has affected you mentally and physically.

Careers and Professional Pathways Principle 2: Prioritize rest and recovery to prevent injuries and allow for better training adaptation over time, leading to improvedrace performance regardless (p. 45).

Careers and Professional Pathways Principle 4: Many triathletes pushtheir running volume and intensity too rapidly, risking injury dueto the high muscular damage caused by running (p. 45).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Careers and Professional Pathways): This is going totake time, and rushing it does more harm than good (p. 45).
Step 2 (Careers and Professional Pathways): The fix lies in consistent and frequent training, balancingintensity with easy runs (p. 45).
Step 3 (Careers and Professional Pathways): A general guideline says that if you are running and still able to hold a conversation with anotherperson, you are probably training efficiently (p. 45).
Step 4 (Careers and Professional Pathways): Running at high intensity for most runsleads to fatigue, muscular damage, and stagnant fitness gains (p. 45).
